depictions.name: Ile des Pins
depictions.text: Île des Pins was an island located in the northwestern reaches of the River Valley in New York. Characterized by a cold climate and thick pine forests, the area was primarily inhabited by black bears. A French fort was eventually established on the northern coast sometime during the 18th century.
